# Embedding-model provenance

Selected runtime model: [intfloat/multilingual-e5-base](https://huggingface.co/intfloat/multilingual-e5-base/tree/d128750597153bb5987e10b1c3493a34e5a4502a), revision `d128750597153bb5987e10b1c3493a34e5a4502a`, 768 dimensions. Original publisher's ONNX and tokenizer artifacts are used directly. The upstream model card declares MIT. Preserved [card](base-experiment/upstream-README.md), [file metadata](base-experiment/upstream-metadata.json), and [hash manifest](base-experiment/model_manifest.json) were recorded before adoption. The directory name records the selection experiment; the model is now selected for runtime.

The runtime [manifest](../../src/research_rag_mcp/model_manifest.json) pins SHA-256 for the full upstream ONNX weights, tokenizer and unmodified README. [Downloader](../../scripts/download_model.py) uses revision-addressed original URLs, verifies all hashes and fails on mismatch. Docker includes the original model card with its assets. Model inference is local CPUExecutionProvider only. No model-source implementation or third-party application code was copied into our implementation. Integration commit is not yet assigned: these changes are uncommitted working-tree development, not an invented historical commit.

Earlier selected/evaluated model: [intfloat/multilingual-e5-small](https://huggingface.co/intfloat/multilingual-e5-small/tree/614241f622f53c4eeff9890bdc4f31cfecc418b3), revision `614241f622f53c4eeff9890bdc4f31cfecc418b3`. Its [card](upstream-README.md), [metadata](upstream-metadata.json) and [manifest](small-model-manifest.json) are retained as history. Small weights are not bundled in the final image. See [Codex's selection assessment](../../docs/semantic-assessment-2026-09-20.md).

Embedding runtime dependencies are pinned in the project lockfile. Original release metadata: [NumPy](numpy-pypi.json), [ONNX Runtime](onnxruntime-pypi.json), [tokenizers](tokenizers-pypi.json). Installed distribution file hashes and required notices are in [dependency inventory](../dependencies.json) and [licenses](../licenses/). The older pre-embedding [inventory](../dependencies-0.1.0.json) remains historical.
